capability: Map FITS primary/IMAGE header, data and padding byte ranges without loading arrays.
pain: A rejected small FITS needs physical HDU boundaries and padding evidence before array interpretation.
contract: 80-byte printable ASCII cards, complete 2880-byte blocks, ordered primary SIMPLE/BITPIX/NAXIS and consecutive NAXISn, IMAGE extensions with EXTEND=T and PCOUNT=0/GCOUNT=1. Dimensions0..4, axis sizes0..1000000, BITPIX8/16/32/64/-32/-64. END and space header padding are required. Nonzero data padding is an exit1 finding. Byte ranges use exclusive ends; no arrays are allocated.
limits: 8 MiB,32 HDUs,144 cards per header. No tables, random groups, compressed extensions, pixel interpretation, scaling, WCS, repair or complete FITS conformance validation. CHECKSUM/DATASUM are explicitly unverified. Nonstructural card values are not semantically validated.
acceptance: Correct two-HDU layout, zero dimensions, float64 data extent, quoted slash handling, malformed card order/duplicates, truncation and nonzero padding.
notes: Astropy and CFITSIO already provide much broader FITS IO and verification; fitsio exposes CFITSIO-backed table/image access. Astroz is a terminal astronomy workflow. No missing HDU-inspection capability is claimed. The precise ranges and strict subset are our interface choice.
overlap: No FITS HDU mapper was found among all198 owned repositories. Existing media inspectors do not implement astronomical block/card semantics.
expected: Exit0: primary data is empty at byte2880; IMAGE data occupies bytes5760..5764 and padding ends at8640.
